deployments.name: ur10e_robotiq_assistant_modes_scene_authoring
deployments.description: Local deployment fixture for assistant-mode catalog plumbing on the UR10e + Robotiq 2F-140 preview stack. It keeps the deterministic scene-authoring provider enabled while declaring the finite tools visible to query and composer-assistant requests.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: Local scene-authoring fixture uses simulated attach actions without an independent grasp confirmation source.

deployments.name: isaac_lite6_lite_gripper_pick_and_place
deployments.description: Retained Isaac commanded-simulation pick-and-place deployment for UFACTORY Lite6 with the articulated lite pneumatic gripper and the source-matched ROS 2 control execution product.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: Isaac Lite6 simulation retains a scoped open-loop grasp acknowledgement while articulated gripper effort, observed state, dwell, contact, and convergence remain separately observable.

deployments.name: isaac_manipulator_scene_light_assistant
deployments.description: Retained Isaac UR10e light-scene deployment with the ROS 2 control execution product and the finite assistant scene-authoring overlay; simulator mutation remains operator-approved.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: The retained Isaac assistant fixture keeps simulated grasp attachment explicitly scoped and observable; assistant output never grants command admission.

deployments.name: isaac_manipulator_scene_light_ros2_control
deployments.description: Retained Isaac UR10e light-scene pick-and-place deployment using the separately retained ROS 2 control execution product, commanded state authority, and Robotiq bridge profile.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: The retained Isaac light-scene fixture keeps simulated grasp attachment explicitly scoped while Robotiq command, observed state, and convergence remain independently visible.

deployments.name: isaac_manipulator_scene_light_ros2_control_collision
deployments.description: Retained Isaac UR10e light-scene collision scenario using commanded ROS 2 control execution, the authoritative runtime collision projection, and Kernel-owned Stop evidence.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: The collision scenario keeps simulated attachment explicitly scoped while collision surveillance and Kernel Stop evidence remain authoritative and independent.

deployments.name: lite6_lite_gripper_pick_and_place
deployments.description: Native ManyForge pick-and-place deployment for UFACTORY Lite6 with the lite pneumatic gripper. The model bundle is self-contained; xarm_ros2 is a generation-time and real-robot runtime dependency only.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: Native Lite6 preview uses backend-authored gripper state and simulated attach actions without an independent grasp confirmation source.

deployments.name: ur5_roboplan_local_pick_place
deployments.description: Local deployment with native in-process RoboPlan planning and simulated execution for the backend-authoritative pick-and-place demo.

deployments.name: ur10e_robotiq_pick_place_preview
deployments.description: Preview deployment for UR10e + Robotiq 2F-140 native RoboPlan pick-and-place demo.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: Native Robotiq preview uses simulated gripper state and attach actions without an independent grasp confirmation source.

deployments.name: ur5_roboplan_local_semantic_shape_pick
deployments.description: Local deployment for the semantic object-selection demo. A model selects one backend-authoritative scene object from a deterministic manifest plus an auxiliary viewer snapshot, and the backend computes the actual pick sequence deterministically from backend scene state.

deployments.name: trocar_lite6_foundationpose_pick
deployments.description: Retained Isaac Lite6 trocar pick deployment using the commanded ROS 2 control runtime and the qualified FoundationPose Detection3D pose-source client.

policy_restoration_inputs.rationale: The FoundationPose fixture keeps simulated grasp attachment explicitly scoped while perception pose freshness, articulated gripper state, and pick/drop effects remain separately observed.

deployments.name: ur5_roboplan_local_vision_guided_pick
deployments.description: Local deployment for the vision-guided bin-pick example. It requires one connected native viewer snapshot source so assistant.query_model can attach a live scene snapshot.

deployments.name: ur5_roboplan_local_vision_guided_pose_pick
deployments.description: Local deployment for the vision-guided pose-pick example. It requires one connected native viewer snapshot source so assistant.query_model can attach a live scene snapshot.
